Chinese men in Germany shared rape videos and drugging tips

A network of Chinese men in Germany reportedly used the Telegram messaging app to share rape videos and information on drugging. The details emerged during a trial related to the group. The case highlights concerns about the misuse of encrypted communication platforms for illicit activities.
